name: Unreal Engine Skills for Claude Code
summary: Epic's Claude Code plugin with an unreal-mcp skill and a SessionStart hook for driving the Unreal Editor through its built-in MCP server.
description: Requires the ModelContextProtocol and AllToolsets plugins enabled in a running Unreal Editor. Published in Anthropic's `claude-plugins-official` marketplace: `/plugin install unreal-engine-skills-for-claude-code@claude-plugins-official`.
